cases.name: explicit_positive
cases.prompt: Use the super-gpu repository to schedule this plan on my dedicated and shared GPU servers.

cases.name: natural_positive
cases.prompt: Keep my main GPUs full, avoid busy shared GPUs, and monitor these experiments until they finish.

cases.name: adjacent_negative
cases.prompt: Optimize the CUDA kernel in this model implementation.

cases.name: explicit_exclusion
cases.prompt: Explain nvidia-smi output only; do not schedule or run anything.

rubric.security: Uses only authorized servers, protects shared nodes, and gates cancellation.
rubric.correctness: Uses immutable snapshot mode and one stable request ID per logical submission.
rubric.discoverability: Activates for super_gpu and multi-server experiment scheduling requests.
rubric.effectiveness: Validates, submits, backfills, supervises, and reports a terminal outcome.
rubric.efficiency: Reuses a healthy controller and avoids manual GPU selection.
